aiResearchSummary.text: Embark Trucks is focused on developing autonomous vehicle technology, particularly in sensor data management and vehicle control systems. They are working on sensor aggregation to streamline data from various sensors, enabling efficient vehicle operation. Their research includes systems for real-time mass estimation of tractor-trailers and methods for lane change determination when encountering vehicles on the shoulder. Additionally, they are exploring emergency vehicle interaction and merge handling based on vehicle intentions. These efforts highlight Embark's commitment to enhancing autonomous driving capabilities.
